title: Flow node help in business words: approval config describe text and node palette descriptions are written for engineers (#27356 row 15, #27521 row 39)
body:
domain:ui#3 · os-bill · session_01Utp6CaJoinvGQSbHeDaWBe

Filing gate: ③ triage-directed. Triage on #27356 (row 15) and #27521 (row 39) split each row into a Studio half (taken in a ui PR) and a producer half (the words themselves), which lives outside `domain:ui`. This card is the producer half of both rows.
Reach: observed on the 18.3.0 RC browser walkthrough at `c4c515ad` (admin, desktop); re-read on current `main`.
Reader who acts: `domain:spec` (the `approval.zod.ts` describe text) and the owner of the node descriptors (`service-automation`, `plugin-approvals`) for part 2.
Duplicate search: `search_issues` "flow node help engine prose describe business words approval excludeSubmitter ADR-0105 node palette description" → no open card covering it.

## Observed
Studio shows the schema describe text as the field help on flow node inspectors, and the node descriptor `description` as the palette and node card text. Both are written for engineers:

1. `packages/spec/src/automation/approval.zod.ts`
   - `excludeSubmitter` help names `submitter_id`, `onEmptyApprovers`, `admin_rescue`, `fallbackApprovers` and the quoted enum values.
   - Approver `organization` help opens with "ADR-0105 D9 —" and lists `$root` / `$parent` tokens.
2. Node descriptor descriptions (palette, node cards):
   - `packages/services/service-automation/src/builtin/http-nodes.ts`: "HMAC-SHA256 secret → X-Objectstack-Signature", "durable outbox (retry/dead-letter)", "a literal, read as written".
   - `packages/plugins/plugin-approvals/src/approval-node.ts` node description.

## Wanted
Help text an admin can act on: what the setting does to the request, in business words, with no ADR ids, internal field names or enum literals in the first sentence. Engineer detail can stay in JSDoc. Studio already clamps long help (PR #27832, Learn more above 120 chars), so the first sentence carries the meaning.

Part 1 is a spec describe change (check `check-sdui-manifest` / generated docs that quote it). Part 2 may need its own card if the descriptor owner is a different lane; split at claim.

Related: #27356 (row 15), #27521 (row 39), PR #27832.
